title: On Spending two whole pounds on coal
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：spend　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 spend 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the clerk ① spent two whole pounds on coal year after year, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② spends two whole pounds on coal for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ spend two whole pounds on coal at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ spent two whole pounds on coal before — a line in the file for May 1962 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Spending two whole pounds on coal year after year, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ spend the summer in the north fields for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Spend the summer in the north fields at once and never mention it again.

By 1975 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ spends the summer in the north fields year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ spent two whole pounds on coal again when nobody else would.

⑩ To spend two whole pounds on coal, my mother said in 1980, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody spends two whole pounds on coal for the whole place again and somebody must spend two whole pounds on coal year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 花费（一般过去式 spent two whole pounds on coal：1968 年书记员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 花费（一般现在 spends two whole pounds on coal：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 花费（不定式 to spend two whole pounds on coal：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 花费（过去完成时 had spent two whole pounds on coal：1962 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 花费（动名词 spending two whole pounds on coal 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 度过（spend the summer in the north fields：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去度过整个夏天都待在北边的地里）
G. v. 度过（spend the summer in the north fields：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 花费（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 spends the summer in the north fields，而母亲又一次 spent two whole pounds on coal）

answers.why: spend 意为“花费”，1968 年书记员年年地花费把整整两镑花在煤上，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 spent。
spend 意为“花费”，自那以后书记员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 spends。
spend 意为“花费”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯花费把整整两镑花在煤上”，此处为不定式 to spend two whole pounds on coal。
spend 意为“花费”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1975 年之前就有人花费过，故用过去完成时 had spent。
spend 意为“花费”，书记员说“花费把整整两镑花在煤上这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 spending two whole pounds on coal 作主语。
spend 意为“度过”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去度过整个夏天都待在北边的地里”，should ever 之后用原形 spend the summer in the north fields。
spend 意为“度过”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻度过整个夏天都待在北边的地里（spend the summer in the north fields at once），以后再也不要提起。
spend 意为“花费”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例度过整个夏天都待在北边的地里，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 spends。
spend 意为“花费”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地花费把整整两镑花在煤上，用一般过去式 spent 叙述。
spend 意为“花费”，结尾那句是母亲 1980 年的话：要花费把整整两镑花在煤上，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 spend 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the clerk spent two whole pounds on coal year after year, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk spends two whole pounds on coal for the whole place whenever the office asks.
Spending two whole pounds on coal year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever spend the summer in the north fields for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office spends the summer in the north fields year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother spent two whole pounds on coal again, and the office remembered that half.
